bodies: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages

exams.name: National Board Certification — Art
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for visual arts teachers, available at early and middle childhood and early adolescence through young adulthood.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Career and Technical Education
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for teachers of career, technical and workforce preparation subjects in secondary schools.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Early Childhood Generalist
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for teachers of children aged three to eight, covering all core subjects in early childhood classrooms.

exams.name: National Board Certification — English Language Arts
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for English teachers at early adolescence and adolescence through young adulthood levels.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Exceptional Needs Specialist
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for special educators, with concentrations spanning mild to severe disabilities and sensory impairments.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Health Education
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for health educators, covering health literacy, risk reduction and skills-based instruction.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Library Media
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for school librarians, covering information literacy instruction, collection development and collaboration.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Literacy: Reading-Language Arts
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for literacy teachers of children aged three to twelve, focused on reading and language arts instruction.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Mathematics
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for mathematics teachers at early adolescence and adolescence through young adulthood levels.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Middle Childhood Generalist
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for teachers of students aged seven to twelve across the elementary curriculum.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Music
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for music educators teaching general, choral and instrumental music across school levels.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Physical Education
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for physical education teachers, covering movement competence, fitness and lifelong activity.

exams.name: National Board Certification — School Counseling
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for school counselors, covering comprehensive counseling programmes and student support systems.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Science
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for science teachers, with pathways in biology, chemistry, physics and earth science content.

exams.name: National Board Certification — Social Studies-History
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for history and social studies teachers at early adolescence and young adulthood levels.

exams.name: National Board Certification — World Languages
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: National Board certificate area for world language teachers, assessing target-language proficiency and communicative instruction.

exams.name: National Board Certification Component 1: Content Knowledge
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: Computer-based assessment of subject-area content knowledge combining selected-response items with constructed-response exercises.

exams.name: National Board Certification Component 2: Differentiation in Instruction
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: Portfolio entry showing how a teacher differentiates instruction, with student work samples and written analysis of learning growth.

exams.name: National Board Certification Component 3: Teaching Practice and Learning Environment
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: Video-based portfolio entry documenting classroom interaction, questioning and the learning environment across two recorded lessons.

exams.name: National Board Certification Component 4: Effective and Reflective Practitioner
exams.body: National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
exams.blurb: Portfolio entry on using assessment data, professional learning and family collaboration to improve student outcomes over time.

exams.name: edTPA Essentials
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: Streamlined two-task redesign of edTPA launching in 2026, with six rubrics per task and greater flexibility in submission timing.

exams.name: edTPA Teacher Performance Assessment
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based performance assessment of planning, instruction and assessment, submitted with video evidence during student teaching.

exams.name: Foundations of Reading Assessment
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: Reading science licensure test adopted by many states, covering phonological awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary and comprehension.

exams.name: National Evaluation Series Assessment of Professional Knowledge
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: NES pedagogy test offered at elementary and secondary levels, covering learners, instruction, assessment and professional responsibilities.

exams.name: National Evaluation Series Essential Academic Skills
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: Basic skills battery in reading, writing and mathematics used by several states as an admission or licensure requirement for teachers.

exams.name: National Evaluation Series Subject Assessments
exams.body: Evaluation Systems, Pearson
exams.blurb: Bank of national content-area tests for teacher licensure that states may adopt individually in place of building custom assessments.

exams.name: ACTFL Listening Proficiency Test
exams.body: American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered assessment rating listening comprehension against the ACTFL proficiency scale for teachers and programme candidates.

exams.name: ACTFL Oral Proficiency Interview
exams.body: American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages
exams.blurb: Live interview rating speaking ability on the ACTFL scale, required by many states for world language teacher licensure.

exams.name: ACTFL Oral Proficiency Interview by Computer
exams.body: American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered speaking assessment rated on the ACTFL scale, offering a scheduled alternative to the live interview format.

exams.name: ACTFL Reading Proficiency Test
exams.body: American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered assessment rating reading comprehension in a target language against the ACTFL proficiency guidelines.

exams.name: ACTFL Writing Proficiency Test
exams.body: American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages
exams.blurb: Written proficiency assessment rated on the ACTFL scale, paired with the OPI for many world language licensure requirements.

exams.name: Google Certified Educator Level 1
exams.body: Google for Education
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering the use of Google Workspace for Education tools such as Classroom, Docs, Drive and Meet in teaching.

exams.name: Google Certified Educator Level 2
exams.body: Google for Education
exams.blurb: Advanced certification on integrating Google tools for differentiation, data analysis, multimedia projects and student collaboration.

exams.name: Google Certified Trainer
exams.body: Google for Education
exams.blurb: Credential for educators who deliver professional development on Google tools, requiring Level 2 certification and a trainer assessment.

exams.name: Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages
exams.body: Cambridge Assessment English
exams.blurb: Initial English teaching qualification combining input sessions with assessed teaching practice, recognised by employers worldwide.

exams.name: Diploma in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages
exams.body: Cambridge Assessment English
exams.blurb: Advanced English teaching qualification with three modules covering theory examination, professional practice and an extended assignment.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified Educator
exams.body: Microsoft
exams.blurb: Certification validating an educator ability to design technology-rich learning experiences using the ICT competency framework.

exams.name: Microsoft Innovative Educator
exams.body: Microsoft
exams.blurb: Recognition programme for teachers who complete Microsoft Learn education courses and apply the tools in classroom practice.
